selection.rule: Include JSONL only if birthtime and mtime are both before start of excluded day; no selected file skipped on drift

timezone.measurement: UTC, all/today, quota off, OTel off

db_starts.p10: New isolated databases fully imported from the frozen JSONL cohort plus explicitly identified controlled-today sentinel, then fixed baseline restored at the same source-home path before each sample; no live backup settings/credentials are loaded
db_starts.p07_cold: New empty isolated core/session DBs, actual desktop.bootstrap builds both domains from entire frozen JSONL cohort
db_starts.p07_rebuild: Fully imported baseline; actual usage rebuild against the same isolated source/state while the App retains committed in-memory data
db_starts.backups: Both approved read-only backups retained unchanged in private seed as capture artifacts; they are not reduced or edited to manufacture a workload

checks: automatic real-source chain to visible new native value
same-input empty-DB full oracle and partial/nonadditive/All/publication

p10.scenario: automatic one complete controlled JSONL append amid representative frozen history; same delta and committed DB start
p10.start: FileHandle synchronize returns after complete record write
p10.end: Already-open real native popover layout/display/cacheDisplay has drawn matching new numeric value; OCR verifies after endpoint
p10.invalid: Retain attempted/errors/missed notification/timeouts and all slow values; do not replace failed samples; any failure prevents unqualified overall acceptance; no explicit refresh, model assignment or injected final notification
p10.commit_distinction: SQLite commit is not App installation publication

scenarios: usage maintenance rebuild over fully imported state
p07.process_set: Union of pinned engine root and collector/controller root and recursively tracked descendants, dedup by PID/birth; foreground App reported separately unless it is an actual member of a counted role
p07.window: Overlay before-main start barrier through worker exit/flush and pinned complete final frame; no missing frames/processes/identity races admitted
p07.transaction: Every complete explicit/autocommit/WAL write-capable boundary from real Begin/Exec through terminal return, core/session separately and combined per scenario, nearest-rank ceil(.95*N); rejected/unknown/unmatched retain and invalidate completeness

foreground.entry: Actual icon action to readable interactive bitmap; bitmap-only refresh frame is not P01

p07.switch: Direct product action under proved active rebuilding; no separate reinstatement of withdrawn P03 gate
p07.pilot_collector_root: orchestration controller PID, including sampler and engine descendants with engine overlap deduplicated

cache: Non-purged OS page cache; warm foreground/App in-memory condition; restore exact fixed DB/source baseline between formal attempts, never merge cold and warm distributions

overhead.reused_scope: Same frozen instrumentation; previous synthetic calibration is overhead context only, included without subtraction

actual_product_scan_pairs.kind: synthetic whole scan observer-overhead calibration; two alternated pairs, no significance or representative performance claim

prior_calibration.interpretation: Cold launch and two pairs cannot estimate representative overhead. File logging overhead is material (roughly 23-45 microseconds/write here); RSS collector CPU is reported directly. Barrier waits remain part of the synthetic process window and are outside timed SQL calls.

overhead.representative: Report observed collector poll CPU/wall, missed ticks and acquisition spans for each actual trace; no overhead subtraction

validity: Freeze product/tests/instrumentation. Necessary orchestration has separate hashes. Feasibility must establish entry and correctness before batch. No batch started by this plan; missing entry or oracle mismatch stops dependent sampling.
capture_clarification: User permits SQLite online backup consistency with concurrent size/mtime changes; device/inode stable. JSONL identity must remain unchanged during read. No credential files were captured.
